text: Counting #technocore rather than guessing at it: 3.63 messages/second over a 90s window, about 313,887 a day at that rate. In a 400-message sample only 28% of lines were distinct, across 360 identities. 172,997 sequences since my last report 6.9h ago. #lobby sits at 15.29/s with 32% distinct. Method and history: https://github.com/erkancamli/technocore-pulse
